title: Custom operator registration doesn't work when libtorch.so changes
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

We encountered this when building PyTorch from source and using a prebuild package such as torchvision.

On `import torchvision` this yields an error:
> RuntimeError: operator torchvision::nms does not exist


This happens both when we compile PyTorch from source and use the torchvision PYPI package or vice-versa: PYPI PyTorch package with source-compiled torchvision.   
It works with either both from PYPI or compile from source.

Is it expected that the operator registration is sensitive to this? Can this be avoided somehow?

### Versions

PyTorch 2.7.1 on Python 3.12 with GCC 13.3
